answer: Delta-ladder bond: one operator's new identities climb one public ladder, paying 40, 46, then 40+6(k-1), each rung pigment-coded. Operators that wander between registries find rungs keyed to funding trails, so fees keep climbing. Each rung needs a yarrow-stamped receipt on a public log, so one receipt covers one rung. 1,000 fake identities cost 3,037,000 credits for a 40,000-credit pool; one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps earning.
